title: Raspberry Pi 5 first boot with U-Boot and the IYAKKI boot loader

steps.do: Write iyakki-rpi5-loader.img, copy the downloaded u-boot.bin to the first partition, connect the serial console and power on.
steps.expect: U-Boot's banner appears on the serial console.

clauses.text: U-Boot finds and starts EFI/BOOT/BOOTAA64.EFI from the card

steps.do: Read the U-Boot lines after the banner.
steps.expect: It reports the removable-media binary efi/boot/bootaa64.efi and starts it; report which storage it scanned first.

clauses.text: the loader reads boot.cfg and starts the kernel and the lean RAM disk

steps.expect: Lines boot: loader started, config: /boot.cfg read, start: iyakki kernel=/kernel8.img, then Linux version and the stage1 lines.

clauses.text: the system comes up as on the baseline card

steps.do: Check Ethernet and HDMI as in the baseline guide.
steps.expect: Each works as on the baseline card, or the difference is reported.

clauses.text: the boot-tries counter and the system's confirmation

steps.do: Restart three times and read the tries_left lines.
steps.expect: Either tries_left is refilled after each good start or it falls by one each time (report it).
